name: Advanced Power Electronics Co., Ltd.
summary: Advanced Power Electronics Co., Ltd. provides power discrete, power IC, and power module products in Taiwan. The company offers thyristors, rectifiers, diodes, and power transistors; and MOSFET (metal oxide semiconductor field effect transistors), IGBT (insulated gate bipolar transistors), bipolar power transistors, and third-generation semiconductors, such as SiC and GaN. Its products are used in computers, communications, automotive, and consumer electronics industries. The company also exports its products to Asia and Other countries. Advanced Power Electronics Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1998 and is headquartered in Zhubei City, Taiwan.
